responsibility: Provides `TyCtxt` helpers for return-position `impl Trait` in traits (RPITIT) when used through trait objects: it determines whether a trait or impl method needs an object-safe RPITIT shim, computes the trait-method generic arguments that should drive that shim, and converts an RPITIT item's bounds into sorted existential predicates with the self type erased for `dyn`/vtable use.
